# Mouf Media - LED Video Wall Solutions

> Premier LED video wall rental, sales, and visual production service in Kozhikode (Calicut), Malappuram, and across Kerala, India.

## Business Overview
- **Business Name**: Mouf Media
- **Primary Service**: Professional Indoor & Outdoor LED Video Wall Rentals and Permanent Commercial Installations
- **Headquarters**: Kozhikode (Calicut), Kerala, India - 673001
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 90615 00511 (090615 00511)
- **Email**: moufmeadia@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://moufmedia.com
- **Base Rental Rate**: ₹120 per sq. ft. (Includes screen panels, video processors, mounting truss, complete cabling, transport, and dedicated on-site sound/video operators)

## Service Areas Across Kerala & Malabar
- **Kozhikode (HQ)**: Beach Road, Mavoor Road, Feroke, Vadakara, Koyilandy, Ramanattukara, Balussery. (2-hour express dispatch)
- **Malappuram**: Manjeri, Perinthalmanna, Tirur, Kottakkal, Nilambur, Edappal, Ponnani.
- **Kannur**: Kannur City, Thalassery, Payyanur, Mattannur, Taliparamba.
- **Wayanad**: Kalpetta, Sulthan Bathery, Mananthavady, Vythiri, Meppadi.
- **Palakkad & Kasaragod**: Ottapalam, Pattambi, Palakkad Town, Kanhangad, Kasaragod.
- **Central & South Kerala**: Thrissur, Kochi (Ernakulam InfoPark), Guruvayur, Angamaly, Kottayam, Kollam, Trivandrum.

## Key Offerings & Technical Capabilities
- **LED Wall Rentals**: High refresh-rate P2.6, P2.9, P3 (Indoor) and P3.9, P4.8 (Waterproof Outdoor) screens for weddings, concerts, conferences, college festivals, and sports screenings.
- **Commercial Sales & Permanent Installations**: Commercial display cabinets, LED modules, NovaStar & Colorlight video processors, and custom auditorium displays.
- **Full Production**: Live camera switching, sound & lighting sync, redundant signal backups, and on-site technicians.
